head: Riaya
sub: رعاية · a private front door to men's reproductive health
vo: In Abu Dhabi, a man often enters the fertility pathway too late. After months of trying. After his wife has already been assessed.

head: Half the picture is missing
sub: Male factors are involved in about half of couples who struggle to conceive. Men are usually assessed last.
vo: Male factors are involved in about half of couples who struggle to conceive. Yet men are usually checked last. Stigma, privacy and inconvenience keep them away.

head: A private front door
sub: No app store. No account. No name. Arabic first.
vo: Riaya is a private front door. No app store, no account, no name. It opens in Arabic, and offers three ways in.

head: Talk it through
sub: Fourteen questions by voice or chat, in Gulf Arabic or English.
vo: He can simply talk it through. By voice or chat, in Gulf Arabic or English. Fourteen questions, about three minutes.

head: Or start with his watch
sub: Sleep, activity, oxygen and glucose, read before a single question.
vo: Or he starts with his watch. Before asking anything, Riaya reads his sleep, activity, oxygen and glucose, and explains what the data already shows.

head: It reads his lab report
sub: Every value, unit and range, checked by him before anything is saved.
vo: He can upload a lab report. Riaya reads every value, unit and reference range, flags anything unusual, and saves nothing until he confirms. The file itself is never kept.

head: Every finding explained
sub: What we saw, why it matters, the evidence, and what it cannot tell him.
vo: Every finding is explained: what was seen, why it matters, how strong the evidence is, and what it cannot tell him. A what-if view shows how much of his signal comes from habits he can change. It is education, never a fertility prediction.

head: One workspace for the doctor
sub: Patient, reasoning and actions side by side, with the evidence one click away
vo: A licensed doctor reviews every specialist referral in one workspace: the patient, the reasoning and the actions side by side. Any factor opens the evidence behind it. Contradictions are flagged, tests already done are not repeated, and overriding the suggestion needs a written reason.

head: Care continues
sub: His journey: every step until he is seen, and what changed since last time.
vo: Care does not stop at a referral. His journey tracks every step until he is seen, what has improved since his last check, and if something stopped him from going, the programme learns why.

head: Population health intelligence
sub: Live, de-identified programme dashboard for ADPHC and DoH
vo: And for Abu Dhabi's health system, every check becomes population intelligence. A live, de-identified dashboard shows how fast men reach care, which habits drive risk across the population, where prevention campaigns would help most, and whether care is fair for every community.

head: Or nothing to install at all
sub: The same check on WhatsApp. One word erases everything.
vo: For men who will not install anything, the same check runs on WhatsApp. One word erases everything.

head: Private by design
sub: One tap hides the screen. Encrypted, stored in the UAE, under his control.
vo: One tap hides the screen. His data is encrypted, kept in the UAE, and shared only when he chooses.

head: 12 days, not 12 months
sub: Simulated pilot: median time from check to clinician. Triage rules matched guideline expectations in 26 of 26 scenarios; independent clinical validation is next.
vo: In our simulated pilot, men reached a clinician in about twelve days instead of more than a year. The triage rules matched guideline expectations in all twenty six test scenarios, and independent clinical validation in Abu Dhabi is our next step.

head: Riaya
vo: Riaya. Because the strongest step is the first one.
